name: Solenne Lychee-Pandan Mist
description: A delicately flavored light soda combining real lychee juice with pandan leaf extract — a Southeast Asian culinary staple now fully mainstream in M88 — producing a soft, almost perfumed drink with minimal sweetness and very fine carbonation.
flavor_profile: Subtle floral lychee, green vanilla-like pandan warmth, barely-there sweetness, almost still effervescence — elegant and understated, easily overlooked or deeply loved
cultural_context: Solenne is a quiet achiever — it never trends, never goes viral, but it has maintained steady sales for eleven years through word of mouth alone. It is the drink most often described by M88 residents as 'what my grandmother gave me,' regardless of actual family background, because pandan and lychee have been domestic staples for two generations. It carries a gentle nostalgia that no marketing budget could manufacture.
story_hooks: Solenne's founder died recently, leaving the company to two children who have fundamentally different visions for its future — one wants to scale up and sell, the other wants to keep it exactly as it is, and the company's single shared production facility is the immediate battleground.

A Tier 5 Spire resident has been secretly funding Solenne for years as a 'preservation project' — keeping a piece of accessible, genuine culture alive — and has just decided to reveal this, with consequences neither party fully anticipated.

The pandan leaf supply for Solenne comes from a vertical farm that has started producing a mutant variety with a subtly different flavor profile — longtime Solenne drinkers can taste the difference and are alarmed, but Solenne hasn't made any public statement.
